decisions.statement: The source globs an entry stylesheet has are written by a machine rather than by an author.
An entry stylesheet is one whose rules import Tailwind.
An app is the folder a vite config sits in above the stylesheet.
The files an app reaches are followed from every file in the app's own tree.
A file is reached by asking the graph what that file reaches.
A glob names where a file the app reaches that a browser draws from sits.
A glob names a folder two below the root rather than the file's own folder.
The app's own tree is named by no glob.
A folder under another the globs already name is left out.
A glob is spelled against the folder the stylesheet sits in.
An inline source list is the author's and is left alone.
The globs go where the first glob was or after the last import where there was no glob.
The globs are worked out again only where the change carries code or a manifest or a stylesheet.
A stylesheet already with the body that would be written again is left alone.
What is written again is answered as a change rather than as a body.
A stylesheet the change does not carry is written again by nothing here.
Nothing here refuses a landing.
Nothing here commits.
A stylesheet is known by its name saying it is a `stylesheet` page's `styles` file.
No file name ending is spelled here.

definition: the trees a Tailwind entry stylesheet reads utilities from, worked out from what its app imports
